card.name: Ends of drug and lab-test names in lists
card.fires_on: The last piece of a drug, hormone or lab-test name inside a comma-separated list, such as the 'in' of digoxin or bilirubin and the 'oids' of corticosteroids. It also fires on a few other list-final nouns.

modes.label: Drug name endings

modes.description: Last piece of an analyte name in a run of lab tests.

modes.label: Other list nouns
modes.description: Closing noun of a condition or activity inside a list.
modes.example: This disease affects more Americans than multiple sclerosis, lupus, lung<< cancer>> or ovarian cancer.

card.plain: It fires when a drug or lab-test name finishes while it sits in a list of similar items.
